faq.q: Does getting a tattoo hurt a lot?
faq.a: It feels different on every body part and for every person. Ribs and fingers sting more than the outer arm, and we pause whenever you need a break.

faq.q: Do you reuse needles or ink?
faq.a: Never. Needles and tubes are single-use and opened in front of you, and ink goes into a fresh cap for every client.

faq.q: Can an old tattoo be covered?
faq.a: Often yes, with a bigger and darker design. The artist looks at the old tattoo in person before suggesting what is realistic.

faq.q: How should I look after a new tattoo?
faq.a: Keep it clean, apply a thin layer of the balm we give you and avoid sun, swimming and scratching while it heals.

faq.q: Do I need to book before coming in?
faq.a: Yes for tattoos, since each design needs time. Piercings can sometimes be done on the same day, so message us to check.
